style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and variants, soft blush-peach #F9E2DB for info and closing shots, mist blue #6E9FD4 fabric fields for texture close-ups
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and soft solid circle accents in coral #F08C7D only
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, gentle diffused front-left key, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft playful kidswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm blush-peach #F9E2DB, mist blue #6E9FD4, charcoal text #33383D and one coral accent #F08C7D; bright soft studio lighting with gentle diffused key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with soft coral circle accents; clean kidswear product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no child model faces anywhere in the set
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the garment across the set; flat-lay garments spread naturally with sleeves visible
style.surfaceSystem: matte pale warm-grey board #F2F2F0 and light natural wood #C9A876 for scene accents
